- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:46-52 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Shared concurrency group key lets push-triggered `claude/**` runs and PR-backed runs on the same branch share one group, so an `[ai-autofix]` push can cancel the active PR autofix run and a PR-open can queue behind a stale push run.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed that gating `cancel-in-progress` on push is insufficient because the group expression still resolves to the same `internal-review-claude/*` value for both event types, so GitHub Actions applies concurrency across runs that should be independent.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: `cancel-in-progress` is only gated on push, but both push and pull_request resolve to the same `internal-review-claude/*` group before job-level checks can run.
